en: How do I check if I am registered to vote?
pcm_draft: How I fit check say I don register to vote?
ha: Ta ya zan duba ko na yi rajistar zaɓe?
yo: Bawo ni ṣe le mọ bóyá mo ti fukọsilẹ lati dibò?
ig: Kedu ka m ga-esi mara ma m edebanyela aha maka ịtụ vootu?

en: What documents do I need to register?
pcm_draft: Wetin I go carry to register?
ha: Wadanne takardu nake buƙata don yin rajista?
yo: Àwọn ákọsílẹ̀ wo ni mo nílò láti fukọsilẹ?
ig: Kedu akwụkwọ ndị m chọrọ iji debanye aha?

en: How do I collect my Permanent Voter Card (PVC)?
pcm_draft: How I go take my PVC?
ha: Ta ya zan karɓi Katina Zaɓe ta Dindindin (PVC)?
yo: Bawo ni ṣe le gba Káàdì Ìdibò Varagba (PVC) tèmí?
ig: Kedu ka m ga-esi nweta Kaadị Ndembanye Aha Ndị na-atụ Vootu (PVC) m?

en: What if my PVC is lost or damaged?
pcm_draft: Wetin I go do if my PVC loss or spoil?
ha: Menene zan yi idan katin zaɓena (PVC) ya ɓace ko ya lalace?
yo: Ki ni mo gbodọ̀ ṣe ti PVC mi ba sọnu tabi baje?
ig: Gịnị ka m ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na PVC m efuo ma ọ bụ mebie?

en: Can I vote without a PVC?
pcm_draft: I fit vote if I no get PVC?
ha: Zan iya yin zaɓe ba tare da katin PVC ba?
yo: Ṣé mo le dibò ní aisi PVC?
ig: M nwere ike ịtụ vootu na-enweghị PVC?

en: What time do polling units open and close?
pcm_draft: Wetin be the time wey polling unit dey open and close?
ha: Karfe nawa ake bude wuraren zaɓe da kulfe su?
yo: Akoko wo ni àwọn ibùdó ìdibò ń si ti wọn si ń tì?
ig: Kedu oge ndị ebe a na-atụ vootu na-emeghe ma na-emechi?

en: How do I find my polling unit?
pcm_draft: How I go find my polling unit?
ha: Ta ya zan gano wajen da zan yi zaɓe (polling unit)?
yo: Bawo ni ṣe le mọ ibùdó ìdibò tèmí?
ig: Kedu ka m ga-esi chọta ebe m ga-atụ vootu?

en: Can I take a photo of my ballot?
pcm_draft: I fit take photo of my ballot paper?
ha: Zan iya ɗaukar hoto katin zaɓena?
yo: Ṣé mo le ya àworan pálí ìdibò mi?
ig: M nwere ike ịse foto pepa vootu m?

en: What support exists for voters with disabilities?
pcm_draft: Wetin dey for people wey get disability to vote?
ha: Wanne tallafi ne akwai ga masu buƙata ta musamman (nakasassu)?
yo: Àwọn ìranlọ́wọ́ wo ni ó wà fún àwọn tó ní àbùkù ara láti dibò?
ig: Kedu enyemaka dị ma maka ndị nwere nkwarụ iji tụọ vootu?

en: Can someone assist me to vote if I cannot see or read?
pcm_draft: Person fit help me vote if I no fit see or read?
ha: Wani zai iya taimaka mini nayi zaɓe idan ban gani ko ban iya karatu ba?
yo: Ṣé ẹnìkan le ràn mí lẹ́ọ́ láti dibò tí mi kò bá ríran tàbí kàwé?
ig: Mmadụ nwere ike inyere m aka ịtụ vootu ma ọ bụrụ na m anaghị ahụ ụzọ ma ọ bụ gụọ akwụkwọ?

en: How are results announced?
pcm_draft: How dem dey announce results?
ha: Ta ya ake sanar da sakamakon zaɓe?
yo: Bawo ni ṣe ń gre àwọn abájáde ìdibò síta?
ig: Kedu ka gọọmentị si kwupụta natijara vootu?

en: Who can declare the official election result?
pcm_draft: Who fit declare the official result?
ha: Waye yake da ikon sanar da sakamakon zaɓe na hukuma?
yo: Tani ó ní ẹ̀tọ́ láti gre abájáde ìdibò gidi síta?
ig: Onye nwere ike ikwu pụta natijara vootu gọọmentị?

en: How do I report vote buying or intimidation?
pcm_draft: How I go report say dem dey buy vote or dey threaten people?
ha: Ta ya zan kai rahoton siyan ƙuri'a ko firgitarwa?
yo: Bawo ni ṣe le ròyìn ríra ìdibò tàbí ìdẹ́rùba?
ig: Kedu ka m ga-esi kọọ gbasara ịzụta vootu ma ọ bụ iyi egwu?

en: Is my vote secret?
pcm_draft: Na secret my vote be?
ha: Shin zaɓina a asirce yake?
yo: Ṣé àṣírí ni ìdibò mi?
ig: Vootu m ọ bụ ihe nzuzo?

en: How can I tell if a viral election message is fake?
pcm_draft: How I fit know say viral election message na fake?
ha: Ta ya zan gane ko saƙon zaɓe da ke yawo na ƙarya ne?
yo: Bawo ni ṣe le mọ bóyá ákọsílẹ̀ ìdibò kan tí ó gbòde jẹ́ èké?
ig: Kedu ka m ga-esi mara ma ozi vootu na-agagharị na ịntanetị ọ bụ nke ụgha?

en: Where can I find official election information?
pcm_draft: Where I fit see correct election information?
ha: Ina zan iya samun ingantattun bayanai game da zaɓe?
yo: Níbo ni mo ti le rí àwọn ìpinnu àti ìroyn ìdibò gidi?
ig: Olee ebe m ga-achọta ezi ozi gbasara vootu?

en: Who is allowed to observe an election?
pcm_draft: Who fit observe election?
ha: Su wane ne aka yarje wa su sa ido a zaɓe?
yo: Àwọn wo ni wọ́n gba láyè láti ṣọ́ ìdibò?
ig: Ndị wo ka a kweere ka ha lebara vootu anya?

en: What happens if I am in the queue when polls close?
pcm_draft: Wetin go happen if I dey queue when polling close?
ha: Menene zai faru idan ina kan layi lokacin da aka rufe zaɓe?
yo: Kí ni yóò ṣẹ́lẹ̀ tí mo bá wà lórí ìlà nígbà tí àkókò ìdibò bá tán?
ig: Gịnị ka ọ ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na m nọ n'ahịrị mgbe ebe a na-atụ vootu mechiri?

en: Can I transfer my registration to a new location?
pcm_draft: I fit move my registration go new place?
ha: Zan iya mayar da rajistata zuwa sabon wuri?
yo: Ṣé mo le yi fukọsilẹ mi pọ̀ sí ibi tuntun?
ig: M nwere ike ịgarfere ndebanye aha m gaa na ebe ọhụrụ?

en: Can I vote if I am outside my state?
pcm_draft: I fit vote if I no dey my state?
ha: Zan iya yin zaɓe idan ina waje da jahata?
yo: Ṣé mo le dibò tí mo bá wà ní ẹ̀yìn ìpínlẹ̀ mi?
ig: M nwere ike ịtụ vootu ma ọ bụrụ na m nọ n'abụghị steeti m?
